pageCache.text:
Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Personal Social Health Education
Personal Social Health Education
Personal, Social, Health, Education (PSHE) at Roding helps children develop essential life skills and emotional intelligence. Through lessons on mental health, relationships, citizenship, and personal safety, children gain the knowledge and values needed to navigate the world responsibly and empathetically. PSHE promotes self-awareness, well-being, and a sense of community, preparing students to lead healthy, balanced, and socially responsible lives.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Maths
At Roding, teaching maths is centred around the mastery approach, which emphasises a deep understanding of concepts. This method allows pupils to explore mathematical concepts thoroughly, ensuring they can apply their knowledge to solve real-world problems confidently. Through hands-on activities, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous assessment, we guide students to build a strong foundation in key areas such as number. Our goal is to foster not only proficiency in maths but also a positive attitude towards the subject, empowering students to see the relevance and beauty of maths in their everyday lives.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Music
Music
In Music education at Roding, children explore the joy of sound, rhythm, and melody through singing, playing instruments, and listening to diverse genres. They learn fundamental music theory, composition, and performance techniques, allowing them to express themselves artistically. Whether through group ensembles or individual practice, children develop musical skills while enhancing creativity, coordination, and teamwork. Our program helps cultivate a deep appreciation for music across cultures and styles.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Science
At Roding, teaching science focusses on sparking curiosity and developing a strong understanding of the natural world. Our Science curriculum encourages children to explore key concepts through hands-on experiments and enquiry-based learning. By fostering critical thinking and problem-solving skills, we help children connect scientific theories to real-life applications. This approach not only builds a solid foundation in Science but also nurtures a sense of wonder and a desire to discover more about how the world works.

Curriculum Subject Areas
Curriculum Subject Areas
At Roding, we teach a wide range of curriculum subjects designed to support the holistic development of our students. From core subjects like Maths and English to creative disciplines such as Art, Music, and Physical Education, our curriculum is structured to cater to diverse interests and strengths. Each subject is delivered by experienced educators who are committed to inspiring a love for learning.
If you would like to find out more about how we teach each subject, click on the individual subjects below.

pageCache.pageTitle: Roding Primary School & Nursery - RSHE Curriculum
pageCache.text:
Free to Achieve
RSHE Curriculum
RSHE Curriculum
At Roding Primary School, our Relationships and Sex Education (RSE) curriculum is designed to equip pupils with the knowledge, skills, and values they need to navigate relationships and personal development confidently and responsibly. Rooted in respect, empathy, and inclusivity, our intent is to foster a safe and supportive environment where students learn to form positive, healthy relationships, understand the importance of consent, and appreciate diversity in all its forms.
We aim to provide age-appropriate, evidence-based teaching that empowers pupils to make informed choices, understand their rights and responsibilities, and embrace their physical, emotional, and mental well-being. Our curriculum aligns with statutory guidelines while reflecting our school’s ethos of kindness and mutual respect, preparing students for life in a diverse and evolving world.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Art
Art
At Roding, teaching Art is all about fostering creativity and self-expression. Our Art curriculum encourages children to explore various mediums such as painting, drawing and sculpture. Through hands-on projects, they develop essential skills in technique, while also learning about art history and cultural influences. We emphasise individual creativity, allowing children to express their unique perspectives and ideas. By nurturing imagination and artistic confidence, our program helps children appreciate the power of visual communication and develop a lifelong appreciation for the arts.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Computing
Computing
At Roding, Computing education equips children with essential digital skills and an understanding of how technology shapes the world. Through lessons in coding, programming, and digital literacy, students learn to create algorithms, develop software, and explore online safety. Hands-on activities and problem-solving tasks allow them to apply computational thinking to real-life challenges. By fostering creativity and logical reasoning, our computing curriculum prepares students for the increasingly digital future.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
English
Teaching writing and reading is fundamental to building strong literacy skills. At Roding, we focus on developing students' abilities to read with comprehension and write with clarity. Through engaging texts and creative writing exercises, students learn to express ideas, expand vocabulary, and understand diverse perspectives. Our approach combines phonics, grammar, and critical thinking, ensuring that students not only become proficient readers and writers but also develop a lifelong love for language and literature.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Geography
Geography
In Geography at Roding, students explore the physical and human aspects of the world around them. They learn about landscapes, environments, and global issues such as climate change, while also examining how human societies interact with the earth. Through map skills and case studies, students develop spatial awareness and a deeper understanding of global connections. This subject encourages curiosity about the planet and a sense of responsibility towards protecting it.

Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
History
At Roding, History helps childre understand the past and its impact on the present. Through the study of significant events, figures, and cultures, students develop a sense of historical perspective and critical thinking skills. By analysing sources, discussing historical interpretations, and exploring global histories, they learn how societies have evolved. Our curriculum emphasises understanding both local and global histories, fostering a deeper appreciation for diverse cultures and the interconnectedness of the world.

pageCache.pageTitle: Roding Primary School & Nursery - PE and Sports Premium
pageCache.text:
Free to Achieve
PE and Sports Premium
PE and Sports Premium
The Government is providing funding for schools to spend on improving the quality of sport and PE for all their children. The sports funding can only be spent on sport and PE provision in schools.
Purpose of funding:
Schools will have to spend the sports funding on improving their provision of PE and sport, but they will have the freedom to choose how they do this.
Possible uses for the funding include: hiring specialist PE teachers or qualified sports coaches, paying for professional development opportunities for sport, running sports competitions, or increasing participation in school games, purchasing sports resources & equipment, and providing places for pupils in after-school sports clubs.
How will we monitor the impact of this funding:
The school will be monitoring both the physical development and engagement levels of pupils through teacher observation and an assessment system and quality assurance measures.
The school will be offering a variety of after-school sports clubs and will be closely monitoring the attendance to ensure maximum take-up.
The school will maximise opportunities for both in school and out of school sporting competitions. The results of the competitions will be shared via the school newsletter which can be found on the website.
The allocation for Roding Primary School for the academic year 2024 - 2025 was £19,440.
The next review will be in July 2026.
For a detailed breakdown of how Roding Primary School spends their Sports Premium, click the button below.

pageCache.pageTitle: Roding Primary School & Nursery - Physical Education
pageCache.text:
Free to Achieve
Curriculum Subject Areas
Physical Education
Physical Education
Physical Education at Roding promotes healthy lifestyles and physical well-being through a wide range of activities, including team sports, fitness exercises, and individual challenges. Children develop strength, coordination, and endurance while learning the importance of teamwork, discipline, and sportsmanship. Our PE curriculum encourages active participation and aims to instill lifelong habits of physical activity, ensuring students understand the value of maintaining both physical and mental health.

Free to Achieve
Parents
At Roding Primary School, our Parent and Friends Association (PFA) is a vibrant and dedicated group that plays a vital role in building a strong school community. The PFA helps raise much-needed funds for the school through exciting events such as the Big Bounce, which not only provide financial support but also brings families together in a fun and engaging way. Their commitment to enhancing the school experience for all children is evident in the time and effort they put into organising activities and fostering a sense of belonging.
The PFA's work helps enrich the educational environment, providing additional resources and memorable experiences for our children.
They are always looking for volunteers from our community.
If you would like to find out more about our PFA, including how you can join and be a part of something special, then please visit their website here.

pageCache.pageTitle: Roding Primary School & Nursery - Remote Learning
pageCache.text:
Free to Achieve
Remote Learning
Remote Learning
At Roding Primary School, we firmly believe that regular attendance is vital for a child’s academic, social, and emotional development. Learning within the school environment fosters collaboration, engagement, and a sense of community that is difficult to replicate remotely.
Remote learning is intended only as a last resort when circumstances prevent in-person attendance, such as during exceptional events or individual cases where students cannot access the classroom. Our aim is to ensure continuity of education during such times, providing pupils with high-quality, accessible resources and maintaining close communication with families.
Through a blend of digital tools and tailored support, we strive to keep pupils engaged and connected to their learning journey. While remote learning cannot fully replace the richness of in-school experiences, it reflects our commitment to safeguarding progress and well-being in challenging situations.
